description: JRN-005 sub-flow 1 picks up where JRN-002 left off. The fraud scoring engine (SVC-013) produced fraud_risk_level=block during the payment initiation. SVC-001 published PaymentFraudBlocked (EVT-186). No funds left the customer account. SVC-013 consumes EVT-186, creates a FraudCase for analyst review and ML pattern learning. No reimbursement required. Case closed with FraudPatternDetected event fed back to the ML model.

context.prior_journey: JRN-002 (Faster Payment Initiation) — Steps PY-001 through PY-002
context.entry_point: PaymentFraudBlocked (EVT-186) published by SVC-001 after SVC-013 returned fraud_risk_level=block on the FraudScoreCompleted event

steps.context: JRN-002 context — prior to JRN-005 entry
steps.label: Publish FraudScoreCompleted (EVT-181): fraud_score=0.96, fraud_risk_level=block
steps.note: This occurs during JRN-002 payment processing. fraud_risk_level=block means the ML model has high confidence this is fraud.

steps.label: Evaluate FraudScoreCompleted. fraud_risk_level=block. Transition PaymentIntent.status=fraud_blocked. Publish PaymentFraudBlocked (EVT-186)
PaymentFraudBlocked event propagates to Digital Channels
Mobile app displays: 'Payment blocked for your security. No money has left your account. Our fraud team will be in touch.'
Consume PaymentFraudBlocked (EVT-186). Create FraudCase (trigger_type=realtime_block, total_loss_amount=0.00, status=open). Publish FraudCaseCreated (EVT-090)
Dispatch notification to PER-001: 'Your payment was blocked. A fraud specialist may contact you. Case reference APP-20260415-000456.'
GET /fraud-cases/{id} — analyst reviews realtime_block case from queue
Publish FraudDataRequested (payment_intent_id) → Event Bus [cross-capability async: CAP-004→CAP-001]
steps.note: Cross-capability boundary: SVC-013 (CAP-004) must not call SVC-001 (CAP-001) synchronously.

steps.label: SVC-001 consumes FraudDataRequested — retrieves PaymentIntent for pattern analysis
Publish FraudDataProvided (amount=£45,000, payee_sort_code=608000, fraud_score=0.96, fraud_risk_level=block, cop_result=no_match)
SVC-013 consumes FraudDataProvided — PaymentIntent data available for pattern analysis
PATCH /fraud-cases/{id} (status=investigating, assigned_analyst={analyst_id}). Publish FraudInvestigationStarted (EVT-091)
POST /fraud-cases/{id}/evidence (evidence_type=transaction_data — ML model features that triggered block, psr_relevance=neutral)
POST /fraud-cases/{id}/evidence (evidence_type=device_data — device consistent with customer profile; no anomaly)
steps.note: Analyst assesses: genuine fraud prevention (true positive) or false positive? Payee sort code 608000 known mule indicator in Cifas data.

steps.label: POST /fraud-cases/{id}/evidence (evidence_type=third_party_report — Cifas mule account indicator on receiving sort code)

steps.note: Analyst assessment: true positive block. High-value payment (£45,000) to known mule sort code. Block was correct. No loss. No reimbursement required.
steps.label: PATCH /fraud-cases/{id} (status=closed, decision_rationale='Real-time block confirmed as true positive. Total loss = £0. Pattern reinforces mule sort code indicator.')
Set FraudCase.closed_at. Publish FraudCaseClosed (EVT-097). Publish FraudPatternDetected (EVT-098) — pattern: high-value payment, no_match CoP, mule sort code indicator, correct block
SVC-013 ML model consumes FraudPatternDetected (EVT-098). Reinforces mule sort code signal in fraud detection model. PSR counter: realtime_block case closed (not a reimbursement claim).
steps.note: FraudPatternDetected closes the loop: confirmed true positives reinforce the ML model's blocking rules

steps.label: Archive FraudCase + FraudEvidence to WORM store (7-year retention)
Optional: Dispatch follow-up notification to PER-001 confirming case closed and payment remains blocked

key_differences_from_happy_path: total_loss_amount = 0.00 — no funds left the customer account
No reimbursement decision or ReimbursementClaim created
Case goes directly from investigating to closed (bypasses decision_pending and reimbursed statuses)
FraudPatternDetected is the primary business outcome — ML model feedback loop
